description: This Java class 'IoUtil' provides utility methods for sending commands, changing RPM, waiting for responses, launching simulators, and connecting to hardware within the Rufesi project. It interacts with core components like LinkManager, SensorCentral, and CommandQueue to facilitate communication and control in engine testing or simulation environments.

classes.name: IoUtil
classes.description: Utility class for engine control commands, sensor interactions, and hardware/simulator management in Rufesi.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command and waits for confirmation, throwing exception if not confirmed.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Overloaded method to send a command with specified retry and total timeout.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a CountDownLatch to reach zero within specified seconds.

methods.name: changeRpm
methods.description: Changes engine RPM, waits for sensor confirmation, and resets engine chart.

methods.name: waitForFirstResponse
methods.description: Waits for initial sensor response indicating system start.

methods.name: launchSimulator
methods.description: Starts a simulator process and establishes TCP connection.

methods.name: realHardwareConnect
methods.description: Connects to real hardware via specified port and registers callbacks.
